description:
Human gate-run status lines — "has not been run yet" and "Passed gate" — go through one renderer in the output module instead of copies across gate arms.

## Background

In `crates/jit/src/main.rs` (or the gate handler modules once moved), the message "Gate '{k}' has not been run yet for issue {id}. Use 'jit gate evaluate' to run it." appears three times in `GateCommands::Status` (findings, flat and default views) and once in `GateCommands::StatusAll`. The pass line "Passed gate '{k}' for issue {id}" appears in `GateCommands::Evaluate`, `EvaluateAll` and `EvaluateMany`. 72d89161 removed the commit-based already-passed skip, so no arm prints an already-passed line or suffix. `print_gate_run_details` and `render_gate_pass_error` are already shared.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: One renderer in the output module prints a gate's run status line for the never-run and passed cases.
- [hard] REQ-02: `gate status` (all views), `gate status-all`, `gate evaluate`, `gate evaluate-all` and `gate evaluate-many` print those lines only through that renderer.
- [hard] REQ-03: `gate evaluate`, `gate evaluate-all` and `gate evaluate-many` report a passed gate with the same passed line, carrying no already-passed suffix, and a test states that output.
- [hard] REQ-04: One unit test owns the renderer's lines; other gate human output is unchanged and the gate suites pass without weakened assertions.

## Notes

The `--json` "not run" output is outside this renderer. 8673dc5e changes how a manually attested gate is reported in `gate status`; the renderer starts from its result. REQ-01 and REQ-03 were narrowed by steward ruling after 72d89161 (plan D-24). Design rationale: `dev/active/df129d9e-rust-code-quality/plan.md`.
title: Render gate run status lines through one output renderer
